# McDonald's Coupon Strategist

A cost optimizer and account auditor for McDonald's China, built on the live menu, store coupons and pricing of the McDonald's China MCP. Chain A prices the cheapest order at one store (combos versus single items, best coupon, filler trap warnings, savings explained). Chain B audits what you are quietly losing: order history profile, coupons about to expire and their silent cost, a net value check of your whole coupon wallet, a redemption schedule for your limited ordering chances, claimable coupons you have not picked up yet, a points account check (balance, expiry, what you can actually still redeem), and the campaign calendar lined up against coupon expiry dates. It never places an order: the only write on your account is claiming coupons with auto-bind-coupons, and only after it lists them and you explicitly agree. Fully offline demo and tests run on the bundled fixtures with no token.
